entities.summary: Louis Graydon Sullivan was an American author and activist known for his work on behalf of transgender men. He was perhaps the first trans man to publicly identify as gay, and is largely responsible for the modern understanding of sexual orientation and gender identity as distinct, unrelated concepts.
